displayName: Recipe: model spend at 50 % or 80 % of the daily ceiling

documentation.content: Today's estimated model spend (settled plus the worst cases of calls in flight, what the breaker compares) passed 50 % or 80 % of today's ceiling (`spend_threshold`: `percent`, `spentMicroUsd`, `ceilingMicroUsd`, `day`). Each threshold is logged at most once per UTC day. Nothing is refused yet. If it is not sales, look at `welcome_granted` (free recipes being farmed) and the owner board's "Model spend per day". See functions/README.md, "Alerts".

conditionMatchedLog.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND jsonPayload.message="spend_threshold" AND jsonPayload.percent=(50 OR 80)
